primary_meaning: Christ as the firstfruits of the resurrection (linked to the wave-sheaf offering)
primary_basis: Leviticus 23:9-14 (barley wave sheaf / firstfruits offering at Passover season)
1 Corinthians 15:20-23 (Christ the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep)
Agricultural calendar of Israel in which barley ripens first, coinciding with Unleavened Bread / Firstfruits

alternatives.meaning: food of the poor, humility, or lowly provision

basis: Judges 7:13 (barley cake tumbling into the Midianite camp in Gideon’s dream)

alternatives.meaning: bitterness or jealousy (grain offering without oil or frankincense)
basis: Numbers 5:15 (barley flour in the ordeal of jealousy)

notes: Barley is not among the most fixed biblical symbols; the firstfruits/resurrection association is the strongest recurring typology in Christian teaching on the feasts, while socio-economic readings (poverty/humility) are frequent in narrative commentaries. No single meaning dominates every tradition.
